description: Customisable settings for the timetable app

name.description: Name of the application. Used in page titles when no short name is set

short_name.description: Short name for the application. Used in page titles and API request headers

logo_light.description: Logo displayed in the top bar when the light theme is active. Either an image URL string or an icon object with a `src`

logo_dark.description: Logo displayed in the top bar when the dark theme is active. Either an image URL string or an icon object with a `src`

block_start.description: First hour of the day (0-24) displayed on the timetable grid. Defaults to `0`

block_end.description: Last hour of the day (0-24) displayed on the timetable grid. Defaults to `24`

use_24_hour_time.description: Whether to show times in 24-hour format. Defaults to `false`

enabled.description: Whether Google Analytics tracking is enabled

tracking_id.description: Google Analytics tracking ID. Analytics is only initialised when this is set

type.description: Type of icon to render. Either `img` or `icon`

src.description: URL of the image icon to display

class.description: CSS class to apply to icon container element

content.description: Content to add to the icon container element
